summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by TIM S.A., a Brazilian telecom, reporting director, related party, and controlling shareholder securities holdings as per CVM Resolution 44/21. It discloses opening and closing balances of common shares for management bodies (board, executive, fiscal council), with no transactions (volume R$ N/A) in the month. There is no merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic change described. This is a routine beneficial ownership disclosure, not a special situation event.
